messages:
Priya (People Ops): FYI we rolled out a focused change to the PTO section of the handbook — routing for approvers now supports a designated backup and explicit carryover caps. Read: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/pto-updates
Liam (HR Manager): for transparency, we also added a short decision matrix for emergency approvals.
Sofia (Eng Manager): quick question: existing pending requests — do they need a manual re-approve or will the system reassign?
Priya (People Ops): system will reassign pending requests to backups automatically; ops will intervene for anything still pending after 48h. If you see an item stuck, run: `hrctl get-requests --status pending --older-than 48h` and tag me.
Marta (Ops): confirmed i can help triage stuck ones during the rollout window.
Sofia (Eng Manager): contractors included? we have one vendor on a recurring schedule.
Priya (People Ops): contractors are excluded from carryover; approvals route to the vendor's org lead. Added note in the handbook.
Marta (Ops): calendar sync is optional per team. If you want auto-OOO on shared calendars leave a comment here and i'll enable for that team.
hr-bot: Assigned: "PTO approver microlearning" to: managers, approvers. Due in 14 days. LMS: https://lms.redwood.ai/courses/pto-approver
Priya (People Ops): action: managers please add primary+backup approvers in this sheet by EOD Friday: https://sheets.redwood.ai/pto-backups. Reply with "ACK" below when completed.
Sofia (Eng Manager): ACK — added eng-platform row, backup is Marta (Ops).
Liam (HR Manager): I'll run a weekly check for the next month and escalate any anomalies.
Priya (People Ops): thanks team — internal FAQ and short changelog will be posted in #docs later today. :white_check_mark:
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Complete PTO approver microlearning" will notify users 3 days before due date.
